bullets.text: Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - A new broadcast on January 22 celebrates Xbox’s 25th anniversary with game insights.
Enhanced Cyber Resilience - Microsoft introduces proactive incident response services to strengthen organizational cybersecurity.
Phishing Attack Insights - Microsoft reveals how complex routing is exploited for sophisticated phishing campaigns.
Defender Experts Suite Launched - New expert-led services aim to bolster security against advanced cyberthreats.
AI Datacenter Innovations - Microsoft’s strategic planning supports large-scale NVIDIA Rubin deployments for AI advancements.
Osmos Acquisition Announced - Microsoft acquires Osmos to enhance autonomous data engineering capabilities in Fabric.
